notes.title: Bug fix
notes.notes:
Here's another patch to fix some issues found on the game:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where sometimes the player lost control during the organize items minigame on Mother Love's storage room
[*]Fixed Mother Love's eyes during some parts of the cutscene on her office when you decide to tell her you're here with Courage
[*]Drawing on the first Free Talk with Mother Love weren't showing but now they are
[*]The OK button from any tutorial popup can be clicked with mouse controls instead of just enter
[*]A clearer dialog on how to interact with the items on Simulation building
[*]Before you get to control Courage from the first time on her room, she explains keyboard and gamepad controls
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed some issues to help you have a better experience:
[list]
[*]Now you have to press shift+S to skip conversations(using just S key could be a little dangerous)
[*]Correctly positioned Courage on her first free talk with you on her computer
[*]Fixed a mouse control issue where the cursor would sometimes select more than one option during conversations
[*]Players who choose to pass dialog by clicking on the yellow arrow on conversation panel cannot advance to the next line of dialog if a tutorial popup is showing
[*]Courage now explains  about the pause menu before you get to control her (some players found the controls unintuitive)
[/list]

Also, I forgot to mention, but ever since the latest BIG update, I had solved an issue where the player couldn't type text with S without starting a skip
